title: Time and attendance: the target-state service blueprint
subtitle: Seven lifecycle stages across four lanes, with the eight failure points the research located. Cells show the target state the Top-10 was scored against; notes name the fix or the constraint.

lanes.name: Physical evidence
cells: Invite and single sign-on || The invitation becomes the sign-on entry point; the email trap is gone.
Published roster and deployment chart || An auto-generated chart replaces the twice-daily paper transcript.
Time clock and mobile punch || Punch confirmation on the device; the whiteboard stays as a fallback.
App countdown || Replaces the hand-timed whiteboard.
Payroll feed and pay advice || Pay advice matches the platform's figures.
Correction record || Every correction leaves a record, not a phantom shift.
Exception and labour reports || Group-level figures compiled automatically.

lanes.name: Frontstage (crew and managers)
cells: Registers, sets a PIN || Welcome in the app; shift visibility follows the record.
Reads shifts, requests changes || Shift list with swap and drop.
Clocks in and out || Punch history and break countdown on phone or clock.
Takes and ends breaks || A visible warning at the five-hour boundary instead of a silent risk.
Reviews hours and pay || Expected pay and live leave balance in the app.
Requests a fix || Correction request with a consent flow and a named owner.
Area leader reviews || Multi-level rollups and exception-rate reporting.

lanes.name: Backstage
cells: Identity check, role sync || Role changes reach the platform late today: an integration defect.
Roster build, forecast feed || Forecast arrives late and short: three weeks sent when four are needed.
Hours accrual, break rules || Hours counted live; open shifts included.
Five-hour boundary logic || Soft warning with an audit trail, negotiated instead of a hard stop.
Cut-off, feed to payroll || Per-store approval status so one store cannot block the run.
Reopen review, change shift to leave || A compliant path cheaper than the workaround.
Exception-rate computation || Issues over published shifts, automated.

lanes.name: Support processes
cells: Employee records, learning platform || Training completions sync late: a tracked defect.
Forecasting system, school calendar || A feature most managers had never heard of.
Time clock fleet, supervisor adjustments || Supervisors adjust forgotten clock-ins by hand.
Compliance rules engine || Warning tiers; few hard stops.
Payroll engine, secure transfer || Payroll absorbs the leave-enquiry load.
Payroll specialist desk || Reopening review with a named owner.
Report build, dashboard || In-house build chosen over a paid per-store add-on.

lanes.name: Failure points
cells: F-01 Email trap blocked shift visibility || The support queue's top mobile cluster; fixed by single sign-on.
F-02 Paper deployment charts; F-08 leave entered shift by shift || Charts transcribed twice a day; a week of leave means every shift by hand.
F-03 No punch history or break visibility || Crew blind to their own clock-ins.
F-04 Silent five-hour risk || A hard stop would have forced fraudulent recording.
F-05 One unapproved store blocks the run || No per-store approval status.
F-06 Phantom-shift corrections || The compliant path was slower than the workaround.
F-07 Manual per-store reporting || Payroll and platform disagreed.

footer: KFC South Pacific, 2024. Drawn by Sam Mozaffari from the engagement's blueprint; vendor, sites and people removed. Rendered September 2026.
